formula: Frozen original group costs/work, updated only by each cell median (candidate_submission/candidate_incumbent)/(anchor_submission/anchor_incumbent) across ALL declared matched full gates; re-sum four operations and whole for each frozen workload, then median across frozen workloads.
assumptions: Champion private-suite group mean costs approximate the same named public-suite groups.
Cross-run hardware cost scale is assumed 1.0; no matched CPU calibration is available.
Both sources use the original gate ns-per-work units; length, shape and value distributions can differ.
scope: INFERRED rough development estimate; original cross-suite/cross-hardware calibration uncertainty is frozen, not resolved. Direct same-suite champion comparison and official admission remain UNKNOWN.
range_scope: Range across frozen anchor workloads after common paired delta; not a confidence interval.
